propositions: rebar's reconciler hardcodes Jira workflow mappings (status, type, priority, link relations, parent relationships) in shipped code, preventing support for projects with non-standard workflows without core edits
a provider-neutral, config-driven mapping seam must be introduced via rebar.toml configuration with layered defaults (built-in → config default → per-project overlay) to make rebar project-agnostic
types with no target analogue must be handled via collapse (round-trip-safe via rebar-type: labels), skip (whole-ticket exclusion), or fail-closed validation at config load
non-allowed transitions must be attempted via replay of the core STATUS event log, falling back to drift when no recorded trail survives (e.g. compacted tickets)
non-representable parents must drift with an echo-safe breadcrumb comment naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key

the mapping core must remain provider-neutral (no Jira-specific literals) with Jira specifics isolated to the adapter, verified by tests that core modules neither import the Jira adapter nor carry Jira value literals
